sv.title: WeftMark
sv.description: Beständiga underlag för programvaruarbete med människor och AI-agenter.

sections.title: Arbetet ska gå att följa
paragraphs: WeftMark håller samman uppgiftens syfte, omfattning, Git-historik, verifieringsunderlag, granskning och överlämning. Projektet är en prototyp.
Frog samordnar fortfarande uppgifter och lås under övergången. Webbplatsen presenterar projektet; den lokala liggaren är fortsatt källa för arbetets underlag.

pages.title: Working with evidence
pages.description: A short guide to WeftMark's distinct implementation, verification and review states.

sections.title: Keep the states distinct
paragraphs: A Change Set binds work to a purpose, declared scopes and Git lineage. Verification evidence describes the exact work it checks; review and publication remain separate decisions.
Read the repository working protocol before changing code. Frog task assignments and locks remain mandatory during the migration.

name: WeftMark
tagline: Durable evidence around transient software work.
description: A vendor-neutral control plane for multi-agent software work: scope, Git lineage, evidence, review and handoff remain inspectable after an agent session ends.
status: Prototype · local runtime and review surfaces implemented

sections.title: Can we explain what happened?
paragraphs: Change Sets bind work to its purpose, declared file and semantic scopes, Git base, branch and worktree. Evidence, review decisions and handoffs are durable records rather than claims in a chat transcript.
Implemented, verified, reviewed and releasable are separate states. A passing command is not proof of publication or an independent review.

sections.title: One responsibility, explicit connections
paragraphs: Frog remains the operational scheduler and lock coordinator during the migration. Sylvae can produce run evidence; Nostoi verifies compatible audit chains; Rebekah packages the self-hosted runtime.
The website introduces the project. Its local ledger and runtime retain authority over engineering work; this page does not expose a remote claim, evidence-execution or review API.

sections.title: Start locally
paragraphs: Install from the source checkout with Python 3.11 or later. Read the installation guide and repository working protocol, then inspect the task, Change Set and evidence interfaces in the CLI.
